patches_modified.name: Badge and logo colors
patches_modified.description: Paints the count badges on the tabs, the Facebook logo at the top of Home and the selected tab in colors you pick. Nothing changes until you type a color. Set them in Hushfacebook settings > Appearance.

patches_modified.name: Clean up Reels
patches_modified.description: Hides clutter on reels, such as the Follow button, comment previews, Remix and Use template buttons and Threads cards between reels, so more of the video shows, and can play each reel once instead of over and over, keep its original audio instead of a Meta AI dub, drop the search suggestions under the caption, over the comments and at the top of a profile's reels, or hide the like, comment and share counts, the Like, Comment, Share, Save or speaker button, or the line naming the reel's sound. It can also open a video you tap in the feed on its own, with no reels after it, stop the "This is taking a while" message when a video is slow to load, and play whole reels in the feed's Reels row instead of the same second over and over, or keep the Comment button on reels with comments turned off so you can read them. Starts off. Turn on the parts you want in Hushfacebook settings > Reels and Watch.

Starts off. Turn on the parts you want in Hushfacebook settings > Reels and Watch.

patches_modified.name: Comment sheet options
patches_modified.description: Small fixes for comments. Stop a long press on Like from opening reactions, hide the GIF and sticker buttons, show every reply without tapping View replies, load a whole reply thread as you scroll, open more replies with a tap anywhere on their row, hide the comments under feed posts or the thumbs-down on comments, hide Related groups under group posts, hide comments with shop links or your words, hide who is typing and the new comments pop-up, hide the emoji row over the comment box, and hide the comment box under full-screen videos. Starts off. Turn on the parts you want in Hushfacebook settings > Comments and writing.

patches_modified.name: Default comment order
patches_modified.description: Opens comments in the order you choose, Most relevant, Newest, All comments or Oldest, instead of the one Facebook picks. Handy if you always want the newest first. Starts off. Turn it on and pick an order in Hushfacebook settings > Comments and writing.

patches_modified.name: Hold a reel for 2x
patches_modified.description: Hold a reel to play it at double speed, and let go to go back to normal. Handy for skimming. The reel's more button still opens Facebook's long-press menu. A second switch does the same for videos playing in the feed and in Watch, and a third keeps the plain 2x pill without Facebook's "Pull down to lock 2x speed" hint. All start off. Turn them on in Hushfacebook settings > Reels and Watch.

patches_added.name: Battery saver
patches_added.description: Lets the phone's audio chip decode songs, so long listens use less battery. BitChord's effects don't run on songs played this way. Inspired by Auris, Prism and Stash. Settings are at the end of the Equalizer page.

patches_added.name: Lossless addons over Bluetooth
patches_added.description: Keeps addons marked lossless in use over Bluetooth, where BitChord normally skips them. Settings are at the end of the Equalizer page.

patches_added.name: Loudness level
patches_added.description: Sets how loud loudness normalisation plays songs, from -23 to -8 LUFS instead of -14. Inspired by Auris, Prism and Stash. Settings are at the end of the Equalizer page.

patches_added.name: Pitch control
patches_added.description: Moves the key up or down by up to 12 semitones without changing the speed. Inspired by Auris, Prism and Stash. Settings are at the end of the Equalizer page.

patches_added.name: Sign in with MicroG
patches_added.description: Offers to sign in to YouTube Music with an account that's already in MicroG RE, instead of Google's sign-in page.

patches_added.name: Sing
patches_added.description: Turns the lead vocal down so you can sing over the song. Ported from the vocal remover in Auris by OreoMuncher45, a fork of BitChord. Settings are at the end of the Equalizer page.

patches_added.name: Sleep timer fade-out
patches_added.description: Fades the song out over 10 seconds before the sleep timer pauses it. Settings are at the end of the Equalizer page.
